meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 报告 bug 时，它会同步 LazyCodex 与上游 Codex 源码、跑最小复现、确认根因，再判断问题归哪个仓库，然后在 GitHub 开 issue（仅 openai/codex 可开 PR），内容含环境、复现步骤、根因与修复建议及验证计划。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或排查 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等的 bug 时触发。根因与复现路径不具体时，它不会提交 issue。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 插件报个 bug，附复现步骤和根因
say.note: 它会先同步源码、跑复现，再开 issue

say.text: 这是上游 Codex CLI 的问题，帮我提个 issue
say.note: 核对源码后路由到 openai/codex

say.text: 这个修复能在 openai/codex 直接开 PR 吗？

howto.what_en: It syncs LazyCodex and upstream Codex sources, runs the smallest reproduction, confirms the root cause, picks the owning repo, then files a GitHub issue (or a PR only for openai/codex) with environment, repro steps, root cause, fix guidance and a verification plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open or triage a bug in LazyCodex, a Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI. It will not file until the root cause and reproduction path are concrete.

say_en.text: Report a LazyCodex plugin bug with repro steps and root cause
say_en.note: It syncs sources, reproduces, then files an issue

say_en.text: This is an upstream Codex CLI bug - file an issue for it
say_en.note: Routed to openai/codex after source check

say_en.text: Can you open a PR for this fix in openai/codex?
say_en.note: PRs only ever go to openai/codex
